name: Roronoa Zoro
description: Wano-end Zoro uses Three Sword Style flying cuts, Haki, Ashura, and King of Hell. Combat-style forms are adaptations, not biology; Ashura's anger gate is tiered activation. Observation is detection. Foxfire, No Sword Style, and many named cuts are omitted.

techniques.name: One Sword Style Iai: Shishi Sonson

forms.name: King of Hell Three Sword Style

techniques.name: King of Hell Three Sword Style

paths.name: Three Sword Mastery
paths.description: A practical Three Sword Style route: stronger and faster flying cuts, longer reach, concealed-target detection, and primary retargeting. Timing and values are gameplay adaptations.

upgrades.name: Tempered Grips
upgrades.description: Adds flat cutting force to ordinary primary hits, providing a reliable early damage increase.

upgrades.name: Rapid Crossing Cuts
upgrades.description: Reduces primary timing, representing faster transitions between Zoro's crossing slashes.

upgrades.name: Long-Range Flying Slash
upgrades.description: Extends primary acquisition reach for encounters where Zoro's cutting waves must cross open space.

upgrades.name: Presence Reading
upgrades.description: Enables primary detection of concealed targets, adapting Zoro's Observation Haki to executable targeting.

upgrades.name: Follow-Through
upgrades.description: Allows one lost primary target to be replaced at resolution without restarting its windup.

paths.name: Haki Swordsmanship
paths.description: Armament and Supreme King Haki route. Armor ignore and damage model hardened defenses and Haki infusion; contact stun is conditional on the target's Manga eligibility flags.

upgrades.name: Armament Hardening
upgrades.description: Lets ordinary damage partially ignore armor, useful against armored or hardened opponents.

upgrades.name: Blackened Blades
upgrades.description: Multiplies primary and Technique damage through stronger Armament Haki swordsmanship.

upgrades.name: Enma's Draw
upgrades.description: A gameplay adaptation of Enma drawing out more Haki: attacks bypass a larger portion of remaining armor.

upgrades.name: Supreme King Infusion
upgrades.description: Adds a stronger multiplicative damage factor for the conscious Haki infusion developed in Wano.

upgrades.name: Conqueror's Impact
upgrades.description: Adds a short contact stun to eligible targets; weak-willed and stunnable checks remain mandatory.

paths.name: Storm of Blades
paths.description: Area-control route for Zoro's whirlwind slashes and extended cutting waves. Pulse stuns remain conditional; emission is damage-only and never propagates other effects.

upgrades.name: Spinning Slashes
upgrades.description: Adds one periodic nearby pulse after primary contact, damaging eligible surrounding targets and attempting a conditional stun.

upgrades.name: Crowd-Cutting Maelstrom
upgrades.description: Replaces the pulse with two wider, more frequent pulses for dense groups of weak-willed enemies.

upgrades.name: Dragon's Reach
upgrades.description: Adds one damage-only emission from the contact point away from Zoro, useful against lines of enemies beyond primary reach.

upgrades.name: Great Dragon Sweep
upgrades.description: Replaces the emission with two longer, wider cutting waves that stop at obstacles and trigger no other effects.

upgrades.name: Kingly Devastation
upgrades.description: Further multiplies damage across Zoro's primary cutting attacks and supported emission damage.
